issue.title: feat(examples): change angular example to ts_project
issue.body:
@alexeagle, not sure who else was interested

So this got more complicated and took a year... :|
* prerendering was dropped because I don't have time to figure it out
* esbuild is used to merge spec files before running karma on them. This replaces concatjs, we can't simply use the compiled-ts and dynamically load all the files at runtime because those files might have cjs/amd etc.
* random other minor changes that were for some reason exposed, see comments on the diff

~~Mainly just a ~~copy~~ refactor of the angular example switching to `ts_project` with `@angular/compiler-cli` as the tsc. However running into a few issues...~~

* ~~ngc is not working with a path error:
```Error: Internal Error: absoluteFrom(src/app/home): path is not absolute"```~~ https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/36291 fixes this
* ~~trying to get a package/module_name referencing a `ts_project` and imported into another
```in deps attribute of ts_project rule //src/app/todos:todos: '//src/shared/material:material' does not have mandatory providers: 'DeclarationInfo'```~~

body:
Just for reference this affects v11 also
Looking forward to the fix!

issue.title: upgrade typescript, add ts_project angular test
issue.body:
I wanted to test a modern version of angular which includes https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/36290, that requires a modern version of typescript. I can move that to a separate PR if wanted.

Main goal was adding a `ts_project(tsc=ngc)` test. When enabling workers something goes wrong, it seems like ngc is no longer used and it uses tsc in the worker. That will be next... either a bug fix or disable workers if a custom `tsc` is passed in as a quick solution?
